title: Stylish Nail Art
description: Do you love nail art and cute fashion styles? Stylish Nail art is the perfect game for you! Create your own beautiful nail designs with colorful nail polish, adorable stickers, and stylish accessories. Try different themes to make every nails look unique and trendy! Mix and match colors, patterns, and decorations to show your creativity and fashion sense. After finishing your nail art, choose a pretty background to complete your masterpiece. Simple, relaxing, and full of fun!

title: Cake Sorting Deluxe
description: Cake Sorting Deluxe is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that challenges your sorting skills! Shift cakes across shelves to make matches of three or more. Clear the board, uncover hidden and shadowed cakes, and solve tricky puzzles as you go. With cute visuals, smooth gameplay, and lots of sweet challenges, Cake Sorting Deluxe is a treat for anyone who loves a good puzzle. Ready to mix, match, and clear the shelves?

title: Save little red hood
description:
Match-3 puzzles combined with physics-based gameplay: eliminate blocks to make stones fall and become Little Red Riding Hood's weapons, which she then uses to attack the wolf.
Plan your elimination route carefully, utilizing gravity to make the stones fall and become weapons—that's the ultimate goal. Various power-ups can also help you.

title: Meow Market
description: In Meow Market, players take on the role of a charming white tabby cat running a bustling vegetable shop. To keep the business thriving, players must harvest fresh veggies by engaging in a click-match puzzle game. Selecting grouped matching vegetables to harvest them efficiently. Each harvest consumes one move, which regenerates over time, encouraging strategic decision-making.

title: Driver Master Simulator
description: Driver Master Simulator is a 3D vehicle driving game. In Truck Mode, your task is to swiftly transport animals to their destinations. All transport missions have tight time constraints. Once you’ve earned $20,000, unlock Bus Mode and take the wheel of a bus. Reach $30,000, and Chopper Mode lets you pilot a helicopter. Feeling cash-strapped? Watch ads to claim $10,000 each time!

title: Bouncy Barn
description:
Bouncy Barn is a lively farm simulation game where players explore the charming world of farm life. Care for cute animals like chickens, cows, and goats. 

Feed and nurture your animals to keep them happy, and in return, they’ll provide valuable produce like eggs and milk. Harvest these goodies and sell them at the market to earn profits for expanding and upgrading your farm. With vibrant graphics and engaging gameplay, Bouncy Barn provides a fun escape to create your dream farm!

title: Summon Tribe
description: Summon Tribe is a simple merge-and-defense game where you combine identical units to create stronger ones to stop enemies. It’s easy, mostly for passing time, and it also supports idle play.

title: Hill Climb Truck Transform Adventure
description: Hill Climb: Truck Transform Adventure is actually a 2D balance stunt adventure game. You have 3 kinds of vehicles to transform and overpass different terrains. While keeping the vehicle balanced, you can climb different ramps and terrains. If you crash obstacles or terrains, you can collect repair plates to recover. If you want to overpass the next harder levels, you can upgrade your vehicles with 4 acceleration abilities.

title: Car Jam Escape
description: Car Jam Escape is a puzzle game where players clear a crowded parking lot by moving cars in the correct order. Each vehicle can only move forward in the direction it faces, so players must study the layout and plan carefully. The goal is to guide every car out without collisions or blockages. As levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring logical thinking and strategy.

title: Obby Parkour Racing
description:
Welcome to Obby Parkour Racing – the game where speed, agility, and style collide to create the ultimate racing challenge!

Jump, grind, and dodge through dynamic obstacle courses on your snowboard! Prove your mastery in a world where parkour isn't just on foot
it's on a board. Every race is a new test, and only the fastest and most agile champions will claim victory.

title: Football Penalty 2026
description: The time has come for the players to face off in an intense duel to prove who has the strongest, most accurate and most technically skilled kick. Show your opponents the power of your accurate shots and become a real football hero. The road to victory is yours!

title: Word Search Universe Easter
description: Word Search Universe: Easter is a fun and relaxing puzzle game with a happy spring theme. Enjoy colorful eggs, soft colors, and a peaceful mood while finding hidden words. Easy to play and great for all ages, it’s a perfect way to relax and enjoy the Easter season.

title: Snake 2048
description: Start as a small cube in this thrilling online game! Eat smaller snakes, dodge stronger ones, and grow into a giant. Enjoy endless challenges, competitive leaderboards, and exciting gameplay. Play now and dominate the arena!

title: Hidden Objects Bakery
description: Explore 6 charming bakery shops in this fun hidden object game! With 24 exciting levels, find 6 hidden bakery items in each shop before time runs out. Perfect for all ages, enjoy the challenge and discover delicious treats in every corner. Can you find them all before time runs out?

title: My City Hospital
description:
My City Hospital is a sophisticated digital doll placement game. Have you ever thought about being a doctor or running a hospital to help others? you can realize your dream without
leaving home. In this game, you run a large hospital with 7 management areas. In this hospital, you can help others deliver babies and take care of babies, examine patients, and help patients
with surgery.

title: Hill Racing - Egg drop!
description:
Press down to accelerate your car. Go as fast as you can carrying an egg while collection coins. 

Upgrade your cars and levels with coins.

title: Snake Hunter
description:
"Snake Hunter" – Giant serpents are invading our homeland! Grab your weapons, fortify our defenses, and slay the monstrous snakes to protect our land.

In this game, you play as a guardian, battling each segment of the serpent's massive body. Collect skills and upgrade buffs dropped by the snakes to enhance your weapon's power and abilities. As you face different serpents across various levels, you'll need to strategically choose skills to counter their attacks and emerge victorious.

title: Trolley fun
description: Trains connect cities and carry goods, but bandits are constantly attacking them! Collect resources, upgrade your train to repel all attacks!

title: Sum Master
description: Sum Master is an engaging and challenging number puzzle game designed to enhance your mental arithmetic and logical reasoning skills. The objective is to select numbers within a grid so that the sums of each row, column, and colored region match the specified targets. Each puzzle has a unique solution, requiring players to carefully consider which numbers to include or exclude. The game offers a stimulating experience that combines fun with educational value.

title: Zoo Restaurant
description: Run the cutest food business ever in Zoo Restaurant! This addictive restaurant game lets you serve adorable animal customers while building an amazing dessert empire. Keep your hungry customers happy while your business keeps growing! It mixes relaxing merge mechanics with fun Simulation gameplay. Fans of restaurant management games will love the rewarding progression system.

title: PrismRoll 3D
description: PrismRoll 3D is a challenging puzzle game where you swipe to roll a 3D block across different tiles to reach the target hole. Navigate through fragile tiles, switches, teleporters, and split mechanics across 100 unique levels. Customize your block with different skins and shapes. Can you beat them all?

title: Braided Hairstyles Fashion
description: Braided Hairstyles Fashion is a beauty game to be the coolest hairstylist! Meet our two main characters: Regina and Kiki and show your braiding skill.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: The Roman Empire Colosseum
description: The war in the colosseum has never been as epic as in this game! Arrange your units and send them into battle! This online game is a battle simulator similar to Totally Accurate Battle Simulator. Your units include warriors, riders, titans, dwarves, mages, and more.

title: FaceChart
description: Do you dream of creating wild, fabulous looks like your favorite artists on social media? Dive into the enchanting realm of Face Chart! Wondering what a face chart is? It's your chic canvas to plan the next jaw-dropping, glamorous look. Grab a piece of paper and let it be your pocket-sized playground—experiment with new colors you hesitated to wear, pick and mix diverse designs for an endless array of possibilities.

title: Nubik: Create Your Place
description:
Nubik: Create Your Place – a game about Nubiks. In this game, you can create your own 'place' – meaning your own game. Choose the game type, build a level from blocks, set Nubik spawn points, and play.

You can play the game solo or with a friend. However, you can also create a 'place' (game) and simply watch how Nubiks (bots) play it.

The game features many skins for Nubiks, achievements, a leaderboard, and chat.

title: Radiant Rush
description: Radiant Rush is a minimalist synthwave drifting game where you control only the car's steering—not its speed. Your goal is to complete increasingly challenging levels while collecting all the datacubes scattered throughout.

title: Happy Monsters 2
description:
A bundle of fun games designed for children of all ages that will delight everyone!

Our little monsters love to play all sorts of games where you collect coins. Help them gather as many as possible to unlock all the toys. Complete the entire toy collection!

title: Merge Heroes Titans
description:
In this game, you will command squads of melee fighters and ranged archers fighting against waves of enemies. Your agility and strategic thinking will give you an edge to victory.

Unlock new powerful fighters and accurate archers by combining those available for purchase. Place them on the map according to abilities and win.

You will have to discover not only new characters, but also beautiful different worlds, enjoy our new game.

title: RiddleMath
description: Math Riddles level up your IQ with a mix of logical puzzles. Challenge yourself with different levels of math games and stretch the limits of your mind. Brain games are prepared with an approach of an IQ test.

title: Stickman Shooter Bros
description:
Stickman Shooter Bros
Ready for action? Choose one of your 3 stickman characters with different powers and defeat your enemies with 4 different weapons.
Melt your enemies with the lava gun, destroy them with the minigun, deal damage from close range with the shotgun, and stun them with the teslagun.
Strong enemies, challenging bosses, and exciting levels await you.
Stickman Shooters is an immersive top-down shooter game.

title: Malatang Master Stack Run 3D
description: Ready to feel the hottest and most fun parkour game ever? In Malatang Master Stack Run 3D, you become a street food chef. Keep running through colorful 3D platform tracks and collecting tasty ingredients to build the tallest skewer stack ever. Slide to collect noodles, Chicken thighs, chili, and more as you dash forward.

title: Tracesoccer
description: Tracesoccer is a modern adaptation of the classic pen-and-paper strategy game, also known as paper soccer or paper hockey. It blends strategic planning with the thrill of competition in a turn-based format, offering exciting gameplay for both casual players and competitive strategists.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: CityMix Solitaire
description:
Play card games, relax and train your memory and brain with CityMix Solitaire. Solitaire CityMix is more than just another game♠♥♠♥!
Which would you prefer: decorating and restoring a quiet town, or solving puzzles and seeking adventure on a lost island? With CityMix Solitaire you can decorate, solve puzzles and mysteries, follow adventures and help brave heroes. Vicky and her pet Raccoon will help in this challenging quest.

title: Grow Castle Defence
description: It's a completely different castle defense game. Strengthen your soldiers and prepare them for battle. Upgrade your archers for a better defense. Fight different enemies by leveling up. Each level adds to the excitement of the game. Watch as the enemies of the pal world evolve as you face them. Earn coins for each enemy and grow stronger.

title: Gun Match Screw
description: a unique level-based puzzle game that combines screw puzzles with exciting gun-themed mechanics. In this game, each level presents you with a board shaped like different guns or gun parts, and your goal is to unlock all the boards by matching colored screws, which are represented as bullets.

title: Mahjong Adventure: World Quest
description:
Welcome traveler, to the most epic quest of all time! Test your Mahjong skills as you journey across the world.

It's time to put everything on the line as you challenge these intriguing yet challenging levels. Complete the quest and witness the wonders of the world.

How quickly can you match the Mahjong tiles? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Mafia Billiard Tricks
description: Mafia Billiard Tricks is a billiard arcade game in which you can play the challenging game of billiards. You are not only playing for fun though however; you opponents are part of the infamous mafia.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Obby Prison Run
description: Obby Prison Run is an intense obstacle course game where escape is the only option—and survival is everything. Sprint, leap, and dodge through deadly traps and twisted takes on classic childhood games. Outsmart your rivals and stay ahead in the race for freedom, where every second counts and only the sharpest make it out alive.

title: Destruction of Stickman Zombie
description:
Take a weapon and destroy the zombie stickmen! "Destruction of Stick Zombie" is an exciting game in which you will fight against hordes of stickman zombies using your skills and strategies. You have to fight zombies to earn coins and improve your weapons.
You start the game as a regular player, but as you progress in the game, you become more experienced and skilled in combat. The more coins you earn, the more weapons and ammo you can buy.

title: Basket Champs
description: Basket Champs is a fun basketball game! Pick your favorite team and compete in the tournament by scoring more points than your opponents.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Angry Chibi Run
description: Angry Chibi RunAn endless sprinting running game. Jump and slide to avoid obstacles and dodge oncoming trains as fast as possible. Choose your favorite character, dress him up and surf the streets to your heart's content! What are you waiting for, come and join the best parkour game ever!

title: Collect Em All
description:
Collect Em All! Is a puzzle game where you connect all the adjacent same colored blocks. Make long chains of colors to create beautiful sounds and unlock explosive power-ups!

Connect the dots to crush them. You can make a limited number of moves, and you cannot go back on yourself, so make sure to plan your path. Create the longest chains for the biggest reward!

 Come back every day to unlock new daily bonuses !

title: Paint Master
description: Fill the squares to match the sample pattern. Tap the brush to paint a straight line of squares in one move. When your moves reach zero the game is over, so use them carefully to clear the stage!

title: PuzzleJam
description:
Puzzle Jam is a bright and fun puzzle game where you merge jellies of the same color to clear the board and complete each level!
Easy controls and smooth gameplay make it accessible for players of all ages . Each level brings a new challenge – find the smartest moves, use boosters, and unlock powerful combos!

title: Knit Rescue
description:
Knit Rescue is an engaging and original puzzle game where you untangle a knitted dragon to save a frightened kitten.

But it’s not enough to simply tap the right spools. You must unlock the correct spools and move them in the right direction to stop the dragon in time.

Plan your moves, follow the arrows, and solve each level using logic and strategy. Knit Rescue is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of brain games, logic puzzles, and strategy games.

title: Tiny Fighter - Unstoppable Run
description:
10 Levels of an exciting and action-packed game that brings player to a mysterious woods and castles. The game begins with a dramatic scenario in which a vampire has stolen the princess and the brave Tiny Knight is the only one who can save her.

As the princess is abducted, the Tiny Knight embarks on a quest to retrieve her by through dangerous woodlands and battle his way through the castle's maze. Along the journey, the knight must fight Orcs, Skeletons and win Dracula to save the princess!

title: Race It: Car Racing
description: Play Race It: Car Racing free online and jump into a high-speed browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Challenge rivals in intense 1v1 city races, swipe to drift, time your boosts, and outsmart opponents in a skill-based brain game of reflex and control. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for quick breaks and nonstop racing action.

title: Dino Hunter King
description: Action-packed FPS games have long attracted players. Enjoy dinosaur hunting in Dino Hunter King. Enter a wild prehistoric world, become an elite hunter tracking powerful dinosaurs across open grasslands.

title: Triangles
description:
If you like to organize your thoughts while playing, then "Triangles" is the game for you.
Combine, connect and match blocks in this exciting challenge that will test your logic skills. This king of puzzles will train your brain and help develop your logic and mental abilities. Don't let the shapes fill the hex grid!
The game will be interesting to fans of games with blocks.

title: Grenade Simulator
description: Begin the most explosive simulator experience ever. Grenade Simulator is an adrenaline-pumping explosion simulator where you can freely throw grenades, drop mines, and trigger massive blasts. This isn’t just a casual game.

title: Zip Zap
description: Step into the fascinating world of Zip Zap, a unique online physics puzzle game that blends mechanics, movement, and precision. Tap, twist, and control your way through clever levels filled with moving parts and intricate structures. Every stage tests your timing and creativity — can you reach every target? Play for free on desktop or mobile and enjoy a perfectly balanced mix of challenge and relaxation.

title: Paw Clash
description: Paw Clash is an exciting party game where cute animals compete in fun challenges. Enjoy a variety of mini-games that test your skills and reflexes in colorful environments. With simple controls and increasing difficulty, Paw Clash offers endless fun for players of all ages.

title: Frog.io
description: Frog io is a 2D PvP game where players control frogs battling for dominance. Use your frog's tongue to devour other players and grow bigger and stronger! As you explore the map, eat fruits and enemy frogs to boost your size and power. But beware other players are after you too! Outsmart them, grow massive, and become the top frog in this dynamic and competitive io game.

title: Bubble Escape
description: Navigate the bubbles to the exit without getting popped by the spikes. More the bubbles escape, more the scores you get. Play through 30 levels. Be careful with the bubble jiggles.

title: sprunki character maker OC
description: The Sprunki Character Maker OC is an interactive tool that allows users to create their own unique characters within the Sprunki universe. Featuring a wide range of customization options, assets, and design tools, it empowers players to craft characters that match the game’s distinctive art style and themes. This experience encourages creativity, self-expression, and deeper engagement with the Sprunki community

title: Pizza Maker
description:
ABC Pizza Maker is a fun and educational cooking game that teaches kids how to make pizza. With different themes like Italian, Unicorn, Candy, and Pirates, kids can let their creativity run wild while learning the steps to make delicious and unique pizzas.

The game features a variety of toppings to decorate the pizza with, and animated scenes for making, baking, and eating the pizza. Designed for toddlers and children, ABC Pizza Maker is a great way to introduce kids to the fun of cooking.

title: Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break and Destroy!
description: Dive into the chaotic fun of ragdoll mayhem! Navigate thrilling challenges by guiding your ragdoll character through each level, leveraging realistic physics for epic destruction. Sharpen your skills and unleash maximum chaos—can you conquer every challenge and emerge victorious?

title: Head Soccer Arena
description: Head Soccer Arena takes you into a fast-paced football world! Play 2-player matches on the same device, dive into quick games, or rise through 15 leagues in Career Mode. Win matches, collect coins and diamonds, and upgrade your power-ups—ice, lightning, anvil, big head, and more! Unlock new characters and dominate the field with strategy, skill, and speed. Every match is a step toward football glory!

title: Sandbox - Destroy the Ragdoll
description:
Ready to destroy and earn? In this sandbox clicker, it's simple: choose your weapon, attack characters, and get paid for the damage you deal. The stronger your attacks, the bigger the reward!  

Use different tactics, unlock new gear, and upgrade your firepower. The further you go, the more powerful the weapons and the greater the possibilities. Ready to become the strongest fighter? Then tap, destroy, and earn!

title: Wave Road 3D
description: Wave Road 3D is a fast-paced reflex game that challenges your focus, timing, and precision. You control a sleek arrow gliding through a floating road filled with gears, traps, and collectible gems. Whether you’re chasing high scores in endless mode, conquering 20 handcrafted levels in classic mode, or racing head-to-head with a friend in 2 player mode, Wave Road 3D offers a refreshing and dynamic experience.

title: Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary
description: Welcome to Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary – the place where your style dreams come to life! Step into the shoes of a talented fashion designer, build your own boutique, and create stunning outfits that dazzle the world. From fabric to final look, you’re in charge of every stitch!

title: Blocksss
description:
Blocksss is challenging, exciting and sometimes infuriating minimalist puzzle game. Enjoy the world's most beloved puzzle game for FREE!
Easy to play, and pleasurable game for all ages.

title: Mob Rush
description: Fun and strategy unite under one roof. Navigate a path filled with obstacles and guide your army through the right gates. Multiply your units and conquer enemy territory. Defend your empire and advance to the next level. Victory or defeat!

title: Idle Airport CEO
description:
Step into the shoes of a savvy CEO and take control of your very own airport!

As you progress, collect passengers and upgrade your capabilities to increase plane capacity, speed, and efficiency. Optimize check-in times, revenue streams, and airline services to keep your customers happy and coming back for more.

Oh, and did we mention that your money is piling up as we speak? Go offline, return and claim profits.

title: Strykon
description:
Strykon is a mobile FPS game with exciting missions and battles. Play different modes like Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Free-for-All, where your goal is to survive.
Choose from many weapons, like pistols, rifles, shotguns, and snipers. Each gun has its own style. Enjoy great graphics, realistic sound, and easy controls. Earn rewards with the Battle Pass to keep the game interesting. Whether you complete missions or fight enemies, this shooter is full of action anytime, anywhere!

title: MineBlocks 3D Maze
description: MineBlocks 3D Maze: A Mind-Bending Adventure in a Blocky World! Get ready to step into a world of puzzles and creativity with MineBlocks 3D Maze—an incredible game that’s perfect for kids and adults alike. If you’re a fan of brain-teasers and enjoy a good challenge, this 3D puzzle game is exactly what you need. It’s all about strategy, logic, and a little bit of muscle (virtual, of course)!  Push the blocks strategically to guide them onto the altars scattered across the level.

title: Fun Mini Games For Princess
description: Welcome to Fun Mini Games For Princess, a collection of mini casual games for kids. Dive into the gaming world and enjoy the fun of playing at your fingertips! Whether you are a casual gamer who looks for relaxation or a skillful player with a purpose, you will find your favorite game and enjoy endless fun in our mini games. Our mini games cover a large range of categories.

title: Dig out of Prison
description:
You are a prisoner determined to break free. Dig tunnels with a spoon, shovel, or anything you can find. Discover valuables, trade with fellow inmates and even the guards, and earn the prison’s top currency — toilet paper.

Upgrade your digging and trading skills, unlock better tools, and speed up your escape. But be careful — plan your moves and avoid drawing attention, because freedom is the prize only for the most cunning.

title: Cannon Blast - The Last Stand
description: You are in control of a cannon and the enemy army is marching towards you. You have to improve your skills, collect coins to buy upgrades, and never retreat because this is The Last Stand.

title: 100 Doors Challenge
description:
Do you like puzzles and hidden object games? Do you play games from the 100 Doors series? Then this point-and-click game is just what you need! Use all your skills to complete all levels and get all achievements.
The main goal in the "100 Doors Challenge" is to get out of the room. Using all the capabilities of the device, you need to open each of the 100 doors and move the elevator to the next floor. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles and use objects to do it!

title: Merge Sesame
description: This is a game anyone can easily learn and enjoy with the whole family!  With addictive sound effects and feedback, complete consecutive combos to relieve stress! If you hit a high combo with an object, your score will soar! There are no penalties or time limits, which means you can enjoy the game at your own pace. If you are looking for wonderful combination effects that are pleasing to the eye, join this game and challenge for the best score.

title: Pet Salon
description: Take care of the cutest pets that you can bathe, and bring to the doctor! Pet Salon is very helpful for the daycare of your pet and have too much fun with this game.

title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
description:
Ready to experience a summer full of Solitaire?
Finally, it's summer! Time to relax! What's better than to lay back, listen to the smooth tunes, enjoy the warm breeze coming from the sea and play some Klondike Solitaire.
Your goal in Solitaire Summer is simple, yet so addictive: Arrange all cards sorted by color in 4 stacks, from lowest to highest value. Can you remove all cards in the correct order and solve the Solitaire Summer puzzle?

title: Battle for the Galaxy
description: Battle for the Galaxy is a cross-platform MMO strategy game set in space. Taking inspiration from the most celebrated sci-fi RTS games, you must build and expand your base and military force powerful enough to attack enemies, loot resources, defend your base, and earn medals.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Diamond mosaic
description: Ready to create your own masterpiece from a scattering of diamonds on your screen? Come to our mosaic!  Fill images with diamond scatter!

title: Super MX - Last Season
description: Super MX - Last Season is a fun dirt bike racing game featuring a range of races and customizations. Challenge and beat your opponents in this entertaining and exciting physics-based driving game.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: 4 Colors Card Mania
description:
4 Colors Card Mania is a thrilling and fast-paced card game inspired by the uno gameplay. Challenge against AI opponents in this colorful and strategic showdown.
Can you outwit your opponents and become the 4 Colors Card Mania champion? 
Shuffle the deck, deal the cards, and get ready for a colorful adventure!

title: Little Commander. Red vs Blue
description: Build and develop your camp! Upgrade your army. Reds versus Blues! Command squads, build tanks and vehicles! Lead a crowd of soldiers! Lead them into battle! Attack and defend! You are the leader, the little commander! Get on the tank and into the battle

title: Puzzle Blocks
description:
Race against time in tense speed battles, employ tactical thinking in rescue missions, and unwind by creating massive structures in free-play mode. Hone your skills assembling perfect puzzles or challenge the ever-accelerating chaos.

Puzzle Blocks is more than a game; it's a curated collection of perfectly crafted puzzles for any mood. The world of puzzles awaits its hero. Can you conquer every challenge?

title: Tap Car
description:
Unveil stunning car masterpieces by solving image puzzles. Every tap reveals more of the picture—can you uncover them all? A must-play for car enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike!

Would you like a few more variations depending on the tone you're aiming for (like more casual, exciting, or elegant)?

title: Portals
description: Portals - HTML5 adventure-puzzle game where two heroes, one black and one white, are stranded on a mysterious planet filled with portals after being swallowed by a black hole. Your mission is to guide them through a series of challenging levels, utilizing their unique abilities to navigate this portal-filled world and find their way home. With intriguing puzzles, captivating graphics, and an immersive storyline, Portals offers a thrilling gaming experience for players of all ages.

title: Fruit Jam
description:
Make juice from fresh fruits in this easy and enjoyable Match-3 puzzle game!
Click on the fruit, if the fruit and the cup are the same color, just squeeze it.

title: Rope Color Sort 3D
description: Rope Color Sort 3D is a creative puzzle game where players need to skillfully sort colorful ropes into their corresponding tubes. The game features beautiful 3D graphics and smooth physics effects, providing players with a relaxing and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Sheep Sort Puzzle Sort Color
description: Sheep Sort Puzzle Sort Color is a fun and addictive puzzle game. You must move the sheep from one enclosure to another in order to match them by color. When all enclosures contain only sheep of the same color, you win. Dozens of challenging levels await your challenge, allowing you to exercise your brain in a fun and colorful environment. Have fun playing!

title: Noob: Jailbreak 2
Super Pop Blast
description: Get ready for a new kind of brick shooter, with unique mechanics, rewarding challenges, and colorful levels. The object: Clear all the blocks using a limited number of balls. Plan your moves, use the score combo system, and try to get 3 stars!

title: Match Ten Number Puzzle
description: Ready to put your brain to the test in a fun and relaxing way? Match Ten - Number Puzzle is a clever puzzle game that combines simple rules with surprisingly deep strategy. Once you start, you won’t want to stop! As levels progress, the board becomes more complex, and every number choice matters. Plan carefully, think ahead, and keep the board under control! If you enjoy number-based puzzle games, this one is a must-play!

title: Fruit Balls: Juicy Fusion
description:
Discover the exciting world of juicy fruits! The task is simple: connect identical fruits to create ever larger and tastier associations, heading towards the treasured watermelon.

- Click on the field
- Connect identical fruits
- Create combinations to get bigger fruits.
- Reach the last level
- Don't let the container overfill
- Earn money for new skins and try to pass with them ???

title: Future War: Bot Battle in Space 3D
description: Future War: Bot Battle in Space 3D is a real-time strategy game that rewards creativity, depth of strategy, and adaptability. Victory depends on your ability to design and deploy customizable and programmable units to dominate the battlefield.

title: Stickman Fight Pro
description: Stickman Fight Pro is an action-packed, fast-paced fighting game featuring simple yet intense gameplay. Players control a stickman character in a variety of challenging arenas, engaging in battles against other stickmen or AI opponents. The game emphasizes quick reflexes, strategic moves, and a variety of weapons and power-ups to outmaneuver and defeat enemies.

title: Annoying Boss Punch Game
description: Step into the craziest office stress-relief adventure with Annoying Boss Punch Game! Smash, slap, punch, and kick your annoying boss in this hilarious web action game built for pure fun and endless entertainment. Tired of boring meetings, overtime pressure, and nonstop office lectures? Release your stress with crazy reactions, funny animations, and chaotic office destruction. Throw punches, launch flying chappals, smash eggs, use water balloons, and create total office madness.

title: Guinea Piggy Matching
description:
Guinea Piggy Match uses well known and easy to learn game mechanics. Your target is to take apart a pattern made of tiles. 
For each completed level, you are given a golden puzzle piece. For these, you can uncover images of cute guinea piggies.

title: Super Football Fever
description: We bring you an unprecedentedly realistic soccer experience with smooth motion-captured animations and lifelike 3D graphics that make you feel like you're on a top-tier league field. Build your dream team, sign superstars, and win matches with precise tactical arrangements. Whether it's quick short passes or stunning long-range goals, you can do it all with ease at your fingertips.

title: Tricky Challenges: Mini Games
description:

Dive into this adorable, fun-filled, and creative game that combines the elements of cats, pets, fashion, and DIY all in one perfect package! Play dress-up game: Try out charming suits on your pet. Decorate an ideal look for your kitten. Enjoy minigames unblocked: Join mini animal parkour games with your little cat.

title: Street Style Fashion
description: Street Style Fashion is a dress-up game where creativity knows no bounds. Dive into the realm of trendy outfits and unlock endless style possibilities.

description:
A classic card game known for its simple and fun mechanics. If you love solitaire games, then this game is just for you! A famous card puzzle game that is popular among players all over the world.
Perfectly relaxing!

title: Relax Mini Games Collection
description: This is a collection of creative and fun mini-games. The game contains a variety of modes, you can DIY ice cream, have cooking for mooncakes, design a car of your favorite, and so on. You cant miss our game if you want to find some relaxation in your busy life.

title: Puzzle Trails
description: Puzzle Trails is a relaxing sliding puzzle game with colorful image categories, progression maps, rewards, bonuses, and score milestones. Solve each puzzle by moving tiles into the correct order, unlock new categories, collect coins and points, and use helpful bonuses when you need support. The game is easy to play, works on desktop and mobile devices, and offers a calm puzzle experience for players of all ages.

title: What's In My Bag?
description: Unpack style and surprises in What’s In My Bag? – the ultimate dress-up and makeup game for fashion lovers! Choose cute outfits, glam makeup, and trendy bags, then reveal what’s inside each one. From influencer props to girly goodies, every bag tells a story. Get creative, show off your style, and join the viral “what’s in my bag” trend now! Perfect for fans of dress-up games, makeup fun, and aesthetic vibes.

title: Cool Girl Aesthetics
description: In Cool Girl Aesthetics, join Mia as she creates her ultimate trendy look! Start by customizing her Stanley cup with fun colors, prints, and accessories. Then, style her headphones, giving them a unique vibe. Next, design her manicure with cool colors, rings, and temporary tattoos for a stylish edge. Complete the look with makeup options like face stickers, colorful braces, and more. Dive into this fun, creative dress-up, and makeover game for endless aesthetic options.

title: Unblock It 3D
description:
Power up your logic and spatial reasoning skills with Unblock It 3D! Rotate the cluster of bricks to find unblocked tiles you can slide away without hitting any obstructions. 

Play Classic Mode and enjoy hundreds of intricate puzzles with unlimited moves, new cube designs and backgrounds to unlock.

Or, journey through time in Adventure Mode. Try your hand at 25 additional levels of increasing complexity and size. Explore Ancient Egypt, Medieval Europe, the Aztec Empire, feudal Japan, and more.

title: Merge Gun Fps Shooting Zombie
description: Merge Gun: FPS Shooting Zombie's main mission is to shoot down all coming undead creatures before they kill you. Before you join the battle, you can buy more guns and merge the same guns into new advanced ones. With more powerful and fast ammo in the clip, you can deal with incoming enemies more easily. Both zombies and crows will move forward to you even if you are still reloading. Keep calm and shoot the explosive oil cans on the ground if necessary.

title: Sniper vs Sniper
description: Sniper vs. Sniper is a game where players compete in sniper shooting skills. Each player takes on the role of a sniper, participating in intense battles with an opponent. Exciting long-distance sniper duels where key skills include accuracy, strategy, and quick reaction.

title: Mini Grand Theft City
description:
Free game of Mini Grand Thef City, an entertaining game based on the famous GTA game in a minimalist world!! In this entertaining game you can walk, run through the streets and assault passers-by to create new buildings!!!

In this incredibly fun little world you will have the freedom to enter homes or businesses to steal furniture or sell it to get more money to build!! It sounds fun, have fun with this game on your favorite device in your favorite browser.

title: Medieval Arena
description: Medieval Arena is a thrilling combat game set in a blocky, immersive battlefield. Choose your path as an Archer, Swordsman, or Berserker, and dive into intense matches.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

description:
Join the fun in Squid Game Subway Craft! Craft your way through obstacles and race along the railway tracks in a Minecraft-style world. Face exciting challenges, meet cool characters, and show your skills as you survive the ultimate test in this action-packed game inspired by Squid Game!"

title: Grunge Chic Alt Fashion
description:
Step into the edgy world of Grunge Chic Alt Fashion, where style meets attitude. This dress-up game lets you explore the perfect mix of grunge edge and chic sophistication.

From plaid skirts and ripped jeans to oversized jackets, fishnets, and combat boots—you’ll have endless options to design your alternative fashion star. Top it off with smoky makeup, bold lipstick, and layered accessories to complete the vibe.

title: Magic Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Sort! — a relaxing and satisfying color-sorting puzzle with a cute cat café twist!
Your job is to organize colorful water layers inside multiple bottles. Each bottle contains mixed colors, and you must pour them carefully to sort every color correctly. Remember:
You can only pour when the top layers are the same color.
Once a bottle is perfectly sorted and filled with a single color, it magically transforms into a finished drink for your adorable cat customers!

title: Airways Maze
description:
This is an Airway game. You have to create the path/airway to move the plane from left to right without colliding any blocks. When you complete the level then unlock the next level. You have 100 levels now. But I will add more levels every 100 downloads.
Enjoy!

title: Room Sort
description: Welcome to Room Sort - Floor Plan Game, the ultimate free puzzle game that combines the fun of tangram puzzles with the creativity of home design. In this engaging game, you’ll rearrange room blocks to complete floor plans. Each room connects through doors, so you'll need to place them perfectly to create a cohesive layout.

title: Goal Rush
description:
Goal Rush is a fast-paced neon football showdown where precision and quick reflexes lead to victory! Play solo against a challenging AI or compete in thrilling 1v1 battles with a friend.

With dynamic arenas, tricky obstacles, and intense goal-scoring action, every match feels fresh and exciting. Outsmart your opponent, master the controls, and dominate the field in this minimal yet action-packed football experience!

Are you ready to take on the challenge and score the ultimate goal?

title: Alien Storm
description: Earth is under attack! A massive alien invasion has begun, and humanity's last hope is in your hands., Battle invading aliens and save Earth in an action-packed arcade adventure.

title: Slicer Duo
description: Slicer Duo is a satisfying ASMR game where precision, timing, and rhythm come together in a sharp slicing adventure. Move through level-based stages, cut through fruits and all kinds of objects, collect points, and try to keep your knife in motion for as long as possible. While the controls are simple, every section demands focus because one bad move can send your knife straight into danger.

title: Onet Monster Book
description:
A "match-the-pairs" genre game where you need to find matching images and connect them. But it's not that simple: there are tons of pictures, and you have to find the right ones.

Match all the books with the same little monsters on the covers — once you've paired them all, the level is complete! With over 100 levels, meditative gameplay, various cute monsters, and beautiful graphics. Play and relax!

title: Winterella
description: Winterella is a beauty game to make a girl to be a fantasy winter princess. Discover the sophisticated fantasy makeup look in icy cold colors.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack
description: Bubble Shooter Candy Wheel Level Pack is a fun and challenging game where you shoot candy bubbles to match three or more on a rotating wheel. Use power-ups like the Bomb to blast nearby candies and the Stopwatch to freeze time for unlimited moves. Earn coins by clearing levels and use them to unlock more exciting levels. With increasing difficulty and sweet rewards, this game promises endless fun. Spin, aim, and conquer the candy wheel!

title: Red Stickman vs Craftmans 2
description: Classic platformer with shooting. Stickman got into the world of Minecraft, flooded with zombie people and zombie animals. Help Stickman destroy all the infected, save Eve and get out of this world.

title: Bonnie Fitness Frenzy
description: Bonnie decides to get her figure in perfect shape for the summer season. Join the girl in her adventures in the gym, where you will perform a variety of exercises to help her burn off extra calories. After intensive training, Bonnie will start applying makeup. And finally, it's time to dress up! Help us choose fashionable and elegant sports outfits to emphasize the fitness style of our heroine. Join Bonnie on her exciting journey to the perfect figure and style!

title: Nose Hospital
description: In Nose Hospital Games, The patients are counting on you in this nose surgery hospital game. Will you rise to the occasion and become the hero in plastic surgery games, they desperately need? Step into the operating theater and redefine the world of nose plastic surgery games.

title: Flower Sort
description:
Sort Flowers is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you sort flowers by type!
Combine three identical flowers in one pot to grow a lush, beautiful bush.
Plan your moves, create satisfying merge chains, and enjoy the colorful and cozy atmosphere.
Each level brings new combinations, vibrant colors, and delightful visual effects.

title: Hidden Kitty
description:
Hidden Kitty is an engaging and delightful hidden object game for kids, available for free! Step into a world of adventure as you help an old lady reunite with her beloved kitties, who are playfully hiding throughout the building.
Embark on a Kitty-Finding Adventure

title: Princesses of Quadrobics
description: Two beautiful princesses, Eliza and the Little Mermaid, are waiting for your help in creating the perfect images for practicing Quadrobics. First, create a gentle but expressive makeup for each of the girls and put your hair in a comfortable hairstyle. Then choose dresses, jewelry and accessories. But the adventures don't end there! Complete the look by putting masks in the form of adorable animals on the princesses. After all, this is a mandatory part of the Quadrobics trend!

title: Voxiom.io
description: Voxiom.io is a 3D real-time multiplayer first-person voxel shooter featuring destructible maps. The game is inspired by popular titles, such as Minecraft, Fortnite, Counter-Strike, and Call of Duty.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game
